<!-- agent-wechat:changesets:start -->
## @agent-wechat/cli 2.9.0

### Minor Changes

- [#623](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/pull/623) [`265bd45`](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/commit/265bd4554c03e1436cc0c07c7e3de94aaafa1271) Thanks [@thisnick](https://github.com/thisnick)! - Stop letting commands the daemon can't apply hold back the sync position.

  - **Skipped, not blocked.** A sync command this build can't apply no longer keeps its batch blocked. This covers status and system controls with no supported effect (including session exit, status opcode 5), updates to your own profile, unknown commands, and message types the profile writer doesn't support, such as contact cards. Deleting an existing contact through an unsupported path, and a recall in a form the daemon doesn't accept, still wait, so neither leaves stale content behind. The daemon applies whatever it supports first; a chat-open or chat-exit notice still clears unread state. Then it keeps the command's raw bytes, emits `account.control_observed` with `projection: "skipped"` and a label of its kind, and lets the batch finish, so the profile's saved sync position moves on. The raw bytes and a note of what was skipped are kept, so a later version can apply them; `wx store usage` lists them under `skippedControls`.
  - **Still waiting.** A command that waits on other local work, such as a group refresh, sticker reconciliation or a contact update with unresolved fields, still holds its batch and emits `projection.blocked`.
  - **Old blocked batches retry on start.** When the daemon starts, it replays batches an earlier version left blocked, the same way `wx store recover-projection` does, so they finish without a manual step.

### Patch Changes

- [#630](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/pull/630) [`997b28e`](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/commit/997b28e934afacbdcdbea8f79c790090b3d90689) Thanks [@thisnick](https://github.com/thisnick)! - Acknowledge sync updates whose follow-up is local work, and finish them in the background, so they no longer hold back the sync position.

  - **Group changes** are acknowledged as soon as their fields are saved. The group refresh that fetches the group's members and announcement runs separately and writes them when it succeeds. A refresh that has given up no longer holds the update forever.
  - **Contact changes** with fields whose order the daemon can't establish, or with field controls it can't read, are acknowledged. One exact lookup of the contact is queued; it refreshes the contact's other fields and a controlled remark. A controlled flag keeps its saved value, and uncertain mute and pin state still keeps notifications suppressed until a newer known update arrives.
  - **An older pinned-chat change** that a newer one superseded is acknowledged without applying it, and the contact is looked up again.
  - **Sticker sync notices** are acknowledged at once. Sticker reconciliation still runs after the sync.
  - **A message already saved under a different time** is finished without writing a second row (label `message_already_in_profile`).
  - **A business-account record the profile writer refuses** (for example no contact type for a new row) is skipped with its raw bytes kept (label `business_contact_unwritable`).
  - **Diagnostics.** A `projection.blocked` entry for a plain error now includes `errorCode` when the error is an identifier-shaped code.

- [#620](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/pull/620) [`c27fe1c`](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/commit/c27fe1cad90158e36d4c1a777b0410acb4568c1b) Thanks [@thisnick](https://github.com/thisnick)! - Complete the recorded WeChatOut, UpdateWxaUsageListNotify and deleteMessages sync controls so they no longer hold a sync batch after the other commands have applied.

  After recovery, `wx store usage` counts only the commands that still block a batch.

- [#612](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/pull/612) [`309f731`](https://github.co

detail.readme:
# Agent WeChat

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**An open source WeChat client for people and AI agents.**

Use an alternative WeChat desktop client, work from the terminal, or connect your
AI agent. Read your conversations, exchange media, and build your own tools on the
same API. Agent WeChat communicates directly with WeChat; its daemon does not
need the official app running.

[Get started](#get-started) · [Documentation](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/) · [OpenClaw](#openclaw) · [Downloads](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/releases)

## See it in action

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/969f95ef-c17a-4e22-bda0-ec9e08af4ad3

[Watch the 93-second demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T5LgL4n1MOQ) ·
[Download the video](docs/public/demo/agent-wechat-demo.mp4)

One conversation with Nick Bot: a question from the phone, a voice reply, an image
request in the desktop client, and saving the result from the terminal. The
recording shows the build used for this demo; current setup and platform status
are linked below.

### A desktop interface

![Agent WeChat desktop showing an image reply from Nick Bot; other conversations are blurred](docs/public/demo/desktop.jpg)

### A WeChat voice call

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/764bc53f-cea2-4b3e-99a1-34fdcb43ec09

## Get started

### Desktop app

1. Download the installer for your platform from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/releases).
2. Choose **Use this device** to run a local hub, or **Connect to another hub**.
3. Add a WeChat profile and follow the sign-in instructions on your phone.

The app includes the chat interface, native hub, and `wx` CLI. See the
[desktop guide](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/setup/desktop/) for
installers, system requirements, connection keys, and networking. Desktop
packaging and installed-app acceptance vary by platform; check the
[platform status](RELEASING.md#platform-release-candidate-acceptance) and release notes for the build you use.

### Terminal and API

Install the native CLI with npm, then start its daemon:

```bash
npm install -g @agent-wechat/cli
wx --json version
wx serve
```

Allow the package's install script so it can download and verify the native
executable. [Installation alternatives](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/setup/install/)
include pnpm, standalone binaries, and Docker. Install FFmpeg and FFprobe on the
daemon host for voice/video preparation; the desktop app bundles them.

For an existing supported **WeChat for Linux** profile, close the official app,
back up its files, and run in a second terminal:

```bash
wx auth login --official
wx accounts list
wx chats list
wx messages list filehelper --limit 5
```

Keep the official app closed while the daemon uses that profile. To create a
separate profile instead, see [Connect your account](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/setup/connect/).
A new profile does not receive your complete old chat history. With several
accounts, select one using `--account ID_OR_ALIAS`.

Once connected, inspect a conversation and save an attachment:

```bash
wx contacts find Alice
wx messages list CHAT_ID --limit 20
wx messages media CHAT_ID MESSAGE_ID --output ./saved-image.jpg
```

See [CLI examples](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/cli/),
[API documentation](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/api/), and
[hosting options](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/setup/run/).

## WeChat features

| Area | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Conversations | Use DMs and groups; browse and search locally stored history; read unread counts and mark chats read. |
| Messages | Send and receive text, images, videos, files, and voice notes; recall eligible own messages and display incoming recalls. |
| Images and video | Preview and download available quality variants, including original images/video; send compressed or full-resolution original images, and normal or original-quality video. |
| Voice notes | Play received notes and send audio as native voice notes. Longer audio can split into multiple notes; playback validation for longer notes remains incomplete. |
| Voice calls | Make and answer direct WeChat voice calls with the [`wx calls` CLI](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/reference/calls/) or the [OpenClaw plugin](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/openclaw/calling/) after enabling voice calling in the plugin. Desktop voice calling is coming soon. |
| Rich content | Read embedded quotes, link-card metadata, and forwarded conversations. Forwarded bundles become text; their nested attachments remain placeholders. |
| WeChat Channels | Receive Channels cards with their cover, publisher, description, and length, and download the post's video. |
| Stickers | Receive stickers, including animated originals. Save images, GIFs, and MOV/MP4 clips as custom stickers; reorder or remove Saved stickers; browse and add eligible free official packs and export a pack as GIFs; send stickers from Saved or added packs. Sends use GIF originals; paid packs are unsupported. |
| Mentions | Send real member mentions or mention everyone where permitted; inspect incoming mention metadata. |
| Contacts | Find people by WeChat ID, send and accept friend requests, and remove contacts while keeping your chat history. Set per-contact privacy with Chats Only, Hide My Posts, and Hide Their Posts. |
| Contacts and groups | Find contacts/groups, search a group's members, read member lists and avatars, and refresh saved metadata. |
| Group management | Create/rename/leave groups, add/remove members, set your group display name, clear announcements, and mute notifications, subject to account permissions. Some profile updates remain partial. |
| Organization | Pin/unpin supported chats and mute/unmute ordinary contacts and groups. |
| Media storage | Configure per-account automatic downloads, save verified media, and inspect transfer progress and unavailable-media status. |
| Desktop | Conversation search and category filters, media views, quote navigation, mention picker, sticker picker, native file saving, tray behavior, and notifications, in English or Simplified Chinese. See platform acceptance status above. |
| Automation | Use the `wx` CLI or authenticated HTTP API; follow replayable events and inspect send/download jobs. |

Media availability depends on the received source, supported formats, and size
limits. Search covers stored history, not all remote history.
See [message types](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/how-it-works/message-types/),
[media](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/media/),
[stickers](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/stickers/),
[groups](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/groups/), and
[contacts and privacy](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/use/contacts/).

## Use your existing official profile

Agent WeChat can read and continue supported writes in an existing official
WeChat for Linux profile **in place**. It retains the account identity and uses
its stored conversations, contacts, groups, and media.

| Profile data | Read | Write |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Messages | Stored history and supported rich content | Newly received and accepted outgoing messages; supported recall updates |
| Contacts | Saved contacts, avatars, friend request history, and contact privacy settings | Supported sync updates, friend request records, contact removals, and privacy changes |
| Groups | Details, rosters, names, and notification settings | Supported synchronized fields and group-operation results; some updates remain partial |
| Media | Supported cached images, video, files, and voice | Supported downloaded/sent cache files and associated resource records |
| Conversation state | Conversations, unread state, supported pin/mute settings | Supported read-state, pinning, and notification updates |
| Saved sign-in | Supported saved account/device information, when WeChat accepts it | Supported accepted sign-in and routing updates |

Offline profile commands can inspect supported stored history, contacts, groups,
and media without a daemon or network connection, using source-preserving
snapshots and the required keys.

Existing-profile compatibility targets recognized Linux layouts. Unknown files
are preserved and unsupported database layouts are refused. General official
search-index maintenance, arbitrary profile migration, and seamless switching
back to the official app are not established. Copy/import/export workflows remain
experimental. See the [native profile guide](packages/native-client-rust/README.md).

## OpenClaw

Connect an agent to WeChat with the `@agent-wechat/agent-wechat` plugin:

```bash
openclaw plugins install @agent-wechat/agent-wechat
```

Then follow [OpenClaw setup](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/openclaw/setup/)
to select the account, create a scoped token, and configure who the agent answers.
DMs and groups are disabled until configured. Replies use the connected account.

| Feature | Support |
| --- | --- |
| DMs and groups | Receive allowed messages and reply in the same WeChat thread. |
| Multimodal input | Images for compatible vision models; received files, videos, and voice notes as attachments, copied into sandboxed agents' workspaces; voice transcription through OpenClaw's configured runtime. |
| Multimodal output | Text, images, videos, files, stickers, and native voice notes. Ordinary audio can remain a file. |
| Group context and mentions | Per-group behavior, real @mention gating, permitted unmentioned messages as context, and outgoing member/everyone mentions. |
| Access policies | Separate DM/group policies, sender allowlists, and per-group overrides. |
| Current-chat tools | `wechat_history`, `wechat_search`, `wechat_message`, and `wechat_media` for stored history and verified attachment retrieval. |
| Optional archive access | `wechat_archive_*` tools can list/search/read all chats in the configured account when granted by agent tool policy. |
| Message actions | `wechat_recall`, quoted replies through `message.replyTo`, and link cards through `wechat_send_share`. |
| Stickers | The owner-only `wechat_stickers` tool lists, previews, saves, reorders, and removes Saved stickers; the message tool's `sticker` action sends a Saved sticker. Official packs are not exposed. |
| Login assistance | `wechat_login` can inspect status, show a login QR, wait for approval, disconnect, log out, or explicitly forget local authentication. |
| Group information | `wechat_group_info` provides owner/admin-authorized cached group/member reads. Group mutation tools are not exposed. |
| Read behavior | Mark chats read after inbound handling, after confirmed model dispatch, or never. This acts on the whole chat through its read boundary. |
| Hosting and recovery | External or plugin-managed daemon; retained event progress across restarts; uncertain sends reported for review rather than blindly resent. |

Default history/media tools stay within the current chat. Archive grants allow
account-wide reads, including from other channels, so grant them only to agents
that should have that access. Media understanding and generation depend on your
configured models and tools. See [agent tools](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/openclaw/tools/),
[access policies](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/openclaw/access/), and
[hosting modes](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/openclaw/modes/).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Desktop[Desktop client] --> API[HTTP API and events]
  CLI[wx CLI] --> API
  Agents[OpenClaw and custom integrations] --> API
  subgraph Host[Your machine or server]
    API --> Daemon[Agent WeChat daemon]
    Daemon --> Profile[(WeChat profile: history, contacts, media)]
    Daemon --> Jobs[(Credentials, jobs, event log)]
  end
  Daemon <-->|WeChat protocol| WeChat[WeChat servers]
```

The Rust daemon handles accounts, synchronization, and media. Clients share an
authenticated API and event stream. Supported message/contact/group state lives
in the WeChat profile; the daemon keeps its credentials, pending work, and
recovery records separately. One writer owns each profile.

The same API used by the desktop app, CLI, and OpenClaw is available for your own
scripts, integrations, and clients. Read the
[architecture guide](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/how-it-works/architecture/)
for the component boundaries and storage model.

Upgrading an older installation? Follow the [migration guide](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/setup/migrate/) and retain your profiles and backups.

## Explore and contribute

Try the client with synthetic accounts and media, without connecting to WeChat:

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm client:dev
```

See the [client preview guide](packages/client-ui/README.md) and
[simulator guide](packages/native-client-rust/crates/wechat-simulator/README.md)
for prerequisites and scenario controls. To build and test changes, start with
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and the
[build guide](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/reference/build/).

The [demo assets and gallery source](docs/demo/gallery/README.md) include the
finished video, screenshots, synthetic visual fixtures, and image-generation
scripts. [Video edit sources](docs/demo/video/README.md) preserve the motion
titles, timing, and original instrumental; private raw recordings stay outside Git.

## License

Agent WeChat's original project code is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
Third-party components retain their existing licenses and notices; see the
[bundled notices](packages/cli/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt), component-specific notices,
and the [Inter font license](docs/demo/video/fonts/OFL.txt).
detail.readme_zh:
# Agent WeChat

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

**面向人与 AI 智能体的开源微信客户端。**

使用另一款微信桌面客户端、直接在终端中操作，或连接你的 AI 智能体。你可以查看会话、交换媒体文件，并基于同一套 API 构建自己的工具。Agent WeChat 直接与微信通信；其 Daemon 无需官方应用保持运行。

[快速上手](#快速上手) · [文档](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/) · [OpenClaw](#openclaw) · [下载](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/releases)

## 效果演示

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/969f95ef-c17a-4e22-bda0-ec9e08af4ad3

[观看 93 秒演示视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T5LgL4n1MOQ) ·
[下载演示视频](docs/public/demo/agent-wechat-demo.mp4)

这是与 Nick Bot 的一段对话：在手机上提问、收到语音回复，在桌面客户端中请求生成图片，然后在终端中保存结果。录屏展示的是本次演示所用的构建版本；当前的安装配置与平台状态请见下方链接。

### 桌面端界面

![Agent WeChat 桌面端展示来自 Nick Bot 的图片回复；其他会话已模糊处理](docs/public/demo/desktop.jpg)

### 微信语音通话

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/764bc53f-cea2-4b3e-99a1-34fdcb43ec09

## 快速上手

### 桌面端应用

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/thisnick/agent-wechat/releases) 下载适用于你所用平台的安装包。
2. 选择 **使用此设备** 以运行本地 Hub，或选择 **连接到其他 Hub**。
3. 添加微信 Profile，并按照手机上的提示完成登录。

应用内置聊天界面、原生 Hub 以及 `wx` CLI。安装包、系统要求、连接密钥和网络配置，请参阅[桌面端指南](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/setup/desktop/)。各平台的桌面端打包与安装后的验收情况有所不同；请根据你所用的版本，查看[平台验收状态](RELEASING.md#platform-release-candidate-acceptance)和发布说明。

### 终端与 API

使用 npm 安装原生 CLI，然后启动其 Daemon：

```bash
npm install -g @agent-wechat/cli
wx --json version
wx serve
```

请允许该软件包的安装脚本运行，以便下载并校验原生可执行文件。[其他安装方式](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/setup/install/)包括 pnpm、独立二进制文件和 Docker。如需进行语音和视频预处理，请在运行 Daemon 的主机上安装 FFmpeg 与 FFprobe；桌面应用已内置这两个组件。

如果你已有受支持的 **Linux 版微信** 官方 Profile，请先关闭官方应用并备份其文件，然后在另一个终端中运行：

```bash
wx auth login --official
wx accounts list
wx chats list
wx messages list filehelper --limit 5
```

Daemon 使用该 Profile 期间，请保持官方应用关闭。如需创建独立的新 Profile，请参阅[连接你的账号](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/setup/connect/)。新 Profile 不会获取你完整的旧聊天记录。如果有多个账号，请使用 `--account ID_OR_ALIAS` 选择其中一个。

连接成功后，即可查看会话并保存附件：

```bash
wx contacts find Alice
wx messages list CHAT_ID --limit 20
wx messages media CHAT_ID MESSAGE_ID --output ./saved-image.jpg
```

更多内容请参阅 [CLI 示例](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/cli/)、[API 文档](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/api/)和[部署方式](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/setup/run/)。

## 微信功能支持

| 领域 | 支持能力 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话 | 支持私聊与群聊；浏览和搜索本地保存的历史记录；查看未读数，并将会话标为已读。 |
| 消息 | 收发文本、图片、视频、文件和语音消息；撤回符合条件的自己发送的消息，并显示收到的撤回通知。 |
| 图片与视频 | 预览并下载可用的画质版本，包括原图和原始视频；发送压缩图片或全分辨率原图，以及普通画质或原始画质的视频。 |
| 语音消息 | 播放收到的语音消息，并将音频发送为原生语音消息。较长的音频可以拆分为多条语音消息；较长语音消息的播放验证仍不完整。 |
| 语音通话 | 在插件中启用语音通话功能后，可通过 [`wx calls` CLI](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/reference/calls/) 或 [OpenClaw 插件](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/openclaw/calling/) 拨打和接听微信一对一语音通话。桌面端语音通话即将推出。 |
| 富文本内容 | 查看引用消息、链接卡片元数据和合并转发的聊天记录。合并转发会转换为文本；其中嵌套的附件保留为占位符。 |
| 微信视频号 | 接收视频号卡片，查看封面、发布者、描述和时长，并下载视频号视频。 |
| 表情 | 接收表情，包括动态原图。将图片、GIF 和 MOV/MP4 片段保存为自定义表情；调整“我的表情”的顺序或移除其中的表情；浏览并添加符合条件的免费官方表情包，并将表情包导出为 GIF；从“我的表情”或已添加的表情包中发送表情。发送使用 GIF 原图；不支持付费表情包。 |
| @ 提醒 | 发送真实的群成员 @ 提醒，或在允许的情况下 @所有人；解析收到消息中的 @ 提醒元数据。 |
| 好友管理 | 通过微信号查找用户、发送和通过好友申请，以及删除联系人并保留聊天记录。可为每位好友设置「仅聊天」「不让对方看我的朋友圈」和「不看对方的朋友圈」。 |
| 联系人与群聊 | 查找联系人和群聊，搜索群成员，读取群成员列表和头像，并刷新已保存的元数据。 |
| 群管理 | 在账号权限允许的范围内，创建、重命名和退出群聊，添加或移除成员，设置你在群内的昵称，清空群公告，以及设置消息免打扰。部分资料更新仍为局部更新。 |
| 会话管理 | 置顶或取消置顶受支持的会话；开启或关闭普通联系人和群聊的消息免打扰。 |
| 媒体存储 | 为每个账号配置自动下载，保存已校验的媒体文件，并查看传输进度和媒体不可用状态。 |
| 桌面端 | 会话搜索与会话分类、媒体查看、引用消息跳转、@ 选择器、表情选择器、系统原生文件保存、托盘行为和系统通知，界面支持英文和简体中文。平台验收状态见上文。 |
| 自动化 | 使用 `wx` CLI 或经身份验证的 HTTP API；跟随可重放的事件流，并查看发送和下载任务。 |

媒体的可用性取决于接收来源、支持的格式和大小限制。搜索仅覆盖已保存的历史记录，不包含远端的全部历史。详见[消息类型](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/how-it-works/message-types/)、[媒体](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/media/)、[表情](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/stickers/)、[群聊](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/groups/)和[联系人与隐私](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/use/contacts/)。

## 使用现有的官方 Profile

Agent WeChat 可以**直接**读取现有的 Linux 版微信官方 Profile（无需迁移），并继续执行受支持的写入操作。它保留账号身份，并使用其中已保存的会话、联系人、群聊和媒体。

| Profile 数据 | 读取 | 写入 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 消息 | 已保存的历史记录及受支持的富文本内容 | 新收到的消息和已被接受的外发消息；受支持的撤回更新 |
| 联系人 | 已保存的联系人、头像、好友申请记录和隐私设置 | 受支持的同步更新、好友申请记录、联系人删除和隐私设置变更 |
| 群聊 | 群详情、成员列表、群名称和消息免打扰设置 | 受支持的同步字段和群操作结果；部分更新仍为局部更新 |
| 媒体 | 受支持的已缓存图片、视频、文件和语音消息 | 受支持的已下载或已发送缓存文件，以及对应的资源记录 |
| 会话状态 | 会话列表、未读状态、受支持的置顶和免打扰设置 | 受支持的已读状态、置顶和消息提醒更新 |
| 登录信息 | 受支持的已保存账号和设备信息（在微信接受的情况下） | 受支持的、已被接受的登录与路由信息更新 |

离线 Profile 命令可以在不启动 Daemon、不连接网络的情况下，借助保留源文件的快照和所需密钥，检视受支持的历史记录、联系人、群聊和媒体。

现有 Profile 的兼容性面向已识别的 Linux 版微信数据布局。未识别的文件会被保留，不受支持的数据库结构会被拒绝。官方搜索索引的通用维护、任意 Profile 迁移以及无缝切换回官方应用，目前尚未得到验证。复制、导入和导出流程仍属实验性功能。详见[原生 Profile 指南](packages/native-client-rust/README.md)。

## OpenClaw

使用 `@agent-wechat/agent-wechat` 插件将 AI 智能体接入微信：

```bash
openclaw plugins install @agent-wechat/agent-wechat
```

然后按照 [OpenClaw 配置指南](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/openclaw/setup/)选择账号、创建限定范围的 API 令牌，并设置智能体回复的对象。在完成配置之前，私聊和群聊均处于禁用状态。回复将使用已连接的微信账号发送。

| 功能 | 支持情况 |
| --- | --- |
| 私聊与群聊 | 接收允许的消息，并在同一微信会话中回复。 |
| 多模态输入 | 支持兼容视觉模型的图片；收到的文件、视频和语音消息会作为附件提供，并复制到沙箱中智能体的工作区；通过 OpenClaw 已配置的运行时进行语音转写。 |
| 多模态输出 | 文本、图片、视频、文件、表情和原生语音消息。普通音频可以保留为文件。 |
| 群聊上下文与 @ 提醒 | 按群设置行为；真实 @ 提醒触发；允许的未 @ 消息作为上下文；外发的成员 @ 提醒和 @所有人。 |
| 访问策略 | 私聊和群聊分别设置策略；发送者白名单；按群覆盖设置。 |
| 当前会话工具 | `wechat_history`、`wechat_search`、`wechat_message` 和 `wechat_media`，用于查询已保存的历史记录并获取已校验的附件。 |
| 可选的归档访问 | 当智能体工具策略授予权限时，`wechat_archive_*` 工具可以列出、搜索和读取账号内的所有会话。 |
| 消息操作 | `wechat_recall`；通过 `message.replyTo` 进行引用回复；通过 `wechat_send_share` 发送链接卡片。 |
| 表情 | 仅限所有者使用的 `wechat_stickers` 工具可以列出、预览、保存、排序和移除“我的表情”；消息工具的 `sticker` 操作可以发送“我的表情”中的表情。不提供官方表情包操作。 |
| 登录辅助 | `wechat_login` 可以查看登录状态、显示登录二维码、等待手机确认、断开连接、退出登录，或明确清除本地认证信息。 |
| 群信息 | `wechat_group_info` 在群主或管理员授权范围内，读取已缓存的群聊和群成员信息。不提供修改群信息的工具。 |
| 已读行为 | 可设置为在入站消息处理后、模型确认分发后标记已读，或从不标记。该操作会通过已读边界作用于整个会话。 |
| 托管与恢复 | 可使用外部 Daemon，或由插件托管；重启后保留事件进度；状态不确定的发送会报告以供人工审核，绝不会被盲目重发。 |

默认的历史记录和媒体工具仅限于当前会话。归档权限允许读取账号内的所有会话（包括来自其他渠道的会话），因此只应授予确实需要该访问范围的智能体。多模态理解与生成取决于你配置的模型和工具。详见[智能体工具](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/openclaw/tools/)、[访问策略](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/openclaw/access/)和[托管模式](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/openclaw/modes/)。

## 工作原理

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Desktop[桌面客户端] --> API[HTTP API 与事件流]
  CLI[wx CLI] --> API
  Agents[OpenClaw 与自定义集成] --> API
  subgraph Host[你的设备或服务器]
    API --> Daemon[Agent WeChat Daemon]
    Daemon --> Profile[(微信 Profile：聊天记录、联系人、媒体)]
    Daemon --> Jobs[(凭据、任务、事件日志)]
  end
  Daemon <-->|微信协议| WeChat[微信服务器]
```

Rust 编写的 Daemon 负责账号、同步和媒体处理。各客户端共享经过身份验证的 API 和事件流。受支持的消息、联系人和群聊状态保存在微信 Profile 中；Daemon 则单独保存凭据、待处理工作和恢复记录。每个 Profile 由唯一的写入者独占。

桌面应用、CLI 和 OpenClaw 使用的同一套 API，同样可用于你自己的脚本、集成和客户端。请阅读[架构指南](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/how-it-works/architecture/)，了解各组件的边界与存储模型。

从旧版本升级？请按照[迁移指南](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/setup/migrate/)操作，并保留你的 Profile 和备份。

## 体验与贡献

无需连接微信，即可使用模拟账号和媒体体验客户端：

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm client:dev
```

前置条件与场景控制，请参阅[客户端预览指南](packages/client-ui/README.md)和[模拟器指南](packages/native-client-rust/crates/wechat-simulator/README.md)。如需构建并测试改动，请先阅读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和[构建指南](https://thisnick.github.io/agent-wechat/zh-cn/reference/build/)。
